holidays.name: National Cranberry Relish Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the tart, zesty side dish that usually hides at the edge of the Thanksgiving table. Fans are encouraged to make a fresh batch with orange zest, nuts, or a splash of something fancy instead of settling for the canned jelly cylinder.
holidays.origin: Like many American food observances, it grew out of food-industry promotion and internet-era calendars of food days, landing on late October as a warm-up for the holiday season.
holidays.funFact: Cranberries are one of only a handful of commercially grown fruits native to North America, and they bounce when ripe, which is why growers once tested them by dropping them down stairs.

holidays.name: National American Catfish Day
holidays.description: A day to appreciate the whiskered bottom-dweller that is a staple of Southern cooking, from crispy fried fillets to cornmeal-crusted baskets with hushpuppies on the side.
holidays.origin: Often tied to the catfish farming industry's promotional efforts, which aimed to raise the profile of farm-raised catfish as a healthy and sustainable American protein.
holidays.funFact: Catfish have taste buds all over their bodies, with some species having over 100,000 of them, so they basically taste the world by swimming through it.

holidays.name: Navy Day (United States)
holidays.description: A day to honor the sailors, ships, and traditions of the U.S. Navy, with ship tours, parades, and plenty of nautical puns and salutes.
holidays.origin: Established in 1922 by the Navy League of the United States, the date was picked to coincide with the birthday of Theodore Roosevelt, a major champion of naval power.
holidays.funFact: Navy Day was largely replaced by the Navy's official birthday celebration on October 13, but October 27 is still marked by many Navy fans and veterans' groups.

holidays.name: Black Cat Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to appreciating black cats, who are unfairly seen as spooky omens and are adopted less often than other cats. Cat lovers share photos of their sleek, shadowy companions and encourage adoption.
holidays.origin: Celebrated in the United Kingdom and observed by animal charities like Cats Protection, it was created to fight old superstitions and boost adoption rates for black cats.
holidays.funFact: In the UK and Ireland, black cats are often considered lucky, while in much of the US they are tied to bad luck, so crossing paths with one depends entirely on which side of the Atlantic you are on.

holidays.name: Mario Day Adjacent: Pastry Appreciation via Teddy Bear Day
holidays.description: Teddy Bear Day is a cuddly celebration of the world's most huggable stuffed companion, with adults and kids alike dusting off their old bears, giving them tea parties, and sometimes getting them tiny outfits.
holidays.origin: Teddy Bear Day is linked to Theodore Roosevelt's birthday on October 27, 1858, and the famous 1902 hunting trip where he refused to shoot a captive bear, inspiring the toy.
holidays.funFact: The teddy bear was named after Roosevelt, whose nickname was 'Teddy', though he reportedly disliked the nickname himself.
